fields.title: Email verification record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of one verdict per address. One EMAIL row per address, one RUN_SUMMARY per run. Unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The address exactly as supplied, before normalisation.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: mx+smtp when the mail server was asked about this mailbox, mx-only when it was not.

_scrapedAt.title: Checked at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

email.title: Email
email.description: The address after trimming and unwrapping any display-name form.

normalizedEmail.title: Normalised email
normalizedEmail.description: Canonical mailbox: lowercased, plus-aliases stripped and Gmail dots removed. Two rows sharing this value are one mailbox.

status.title: Status
status.description: deliverable, undeliverable, risky or unknown. The four are exclusive and unknown is never folded into the others.

subStatus.title: Reason code
subStatus.description: Machine-readable reason: mailbox_exists, mailbox_not_found, nxdomain, no_mx_record, disposable, catch_all, role_account, domain_typo, mx_only, dns_unavailable or a syntax error code.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0-100 confidence that sending here is safe. 98 = the server accepted it, 0 = it will bounce.

safeToSend.title: Safe to send
safeToSend.description: True only for confirmed deliverable addresses. Risky and unknown both answer false on purpose.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: One sentence explaining the verdict in the terms a sender cares about.

syntaxValid.title: Syntax valid
syntaxValid.description: Whether the address parses as a real mailbox at all.

syntaxError.title: Syntax error
syntaxError.description: Which rule it broke: missing_or_multiple_at, consecutive_dots, contains_space, domain_has_no_tld, local_part_too_long, too_long, invalid_characters.

domainStatus.title: Domain status
domainStatus.description: ok, no_mx, nxdomain, dns_timeout or dns_error.

mxHost.title: MX host
mxHost.description: Lowest-preference mail exchanger, the host that was probed.

mxRecords.title: MX records
mxRecords.description: Full MX list with preferences, lowest first.

implicitMx.title: Implicit MX
implicitMx.description: True when the domain publishes no MX and the A record is being used as the implicit exchanger, per RFC 5321.

dnsError.title: DNS error
dnsError.description: Why the lookup failed, when it did.

smtpChecked.title: SMTP checked
smtpChecked.description: Whether an SMTP conversation actually happened for this address.

smtpCode.title: SMTP code
smtpCode.description: Reply code to RCPT TO. 250/251 accept, 550/551/553/554 reject, 421/450/451/452 defer.

smtpMessage.title: SMTP message
smtpMessage.description: The server's own words, kept verbatim so a surprising verdict can be audited.

smtpDeliverable.title: SMTP deliverable
smtpDeliverable.description: True accepted, false rejected, null no usable answer. Greylisting and throttling land on null, never on false.

smtpStage.title: SMTP stage
smtpStage.description: Where the conversation ended: rcpt_to, banner, ehlo, mail_from, timeout, connect_failed, skipped_port_blocked, skipped_no_mx or skipped_disabled.

isCatchAll.title: Catch-all domain
isCatchAll.description: True when the domain accepted a random address too, so acceptance proves nothing about this mailbox.

isRoleAccount.title: Role mailbox
isRoleAccount.description: info@, sales@, support@ and the like - a function, not a person.

isFreeProvider.title: Free provider
isFreeProvider.description: Consumer mailbox provider such as Gmail or Outlook.

isDisposable.title: Disposable
isDisposable.description: Throwaway provider, matched by domain or by the MX host behind it.

isAlias.title: Alias
isAlias.description: The address uses plus-addressing or Gmail dots, so it is a variant of normalizedEmail.

hasTypo.title: Typo suspected
hasTypo.description: The domain is within two edits of a major provider without being one.

suggestedEmail.title: Suggested correction
suggestedEmail.description: The repaired address when a typo is suspected.

checkDurationMs.title: Check duration (ms)
checkDurationMs.description: Wall-clock time spent on this address.

emailsChecked.title: Emails checked
emailsChecked.description: RUN_SUMMARY: how many addresses were verified after de-duplication.

deliverableRate.title: Deliverable rate
deliverableRate.description: RUN_SUMMARY: share of the list confirmed deliverable.

smtpRoute.title: SMTP route
smtpRoute.description: RUN_SUMMARY: direct, proxy-connect or none - how the run tried to reach port 25.

smtpPortReachable.title: SMTP port reachable
smtpPortReachable.description: RUN_SUMMARY: whether outbound port 25 worked from this run. False means every unknown above is an infrastructure limit, not a property of the address.

smtpEgressDetail.title: SMTP egress detail
smtpEgressDetail.description: RUN_SUMMARY: the banner received, or the error that proved port 25 is blocked.

statusBreakdown.title: Status breakdown
statusBreakdown.description: RUN_SUMMARY: counts per status, largest first.

reasonBreakdown.title: Reason breakdown
reasonBreakdown.description: RUN_SUMMARY: counts per reason code, largest first.

duplicatesRemoved.title: Duplicates removed
duplicatesRemoved.description: RUN_SUMMARY: addresses dropped before verification because they repeated.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: The verdict per address - the columns you sort and delete on.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: What the DNS and the mail server actually said.
